compactRecord.rs: A modest forested pre-alpine saddle of purely local significance, with three hairpins and a ~6% gradient offering mild driving interest; a wayside chapel and Napoleonic cross add slight summit appeal, boosted marginally by a 2012 Österreich-Rundfahrt appearance.
compactRecord.td: The Moarigrabensattel (698 m) is a quiet, forested pass in the Türnitzer Alpen linking the Pielach and Traisen valleys via a narrow local road with three hairpin turns. Its modest summit hosts a wayside chapel and a Napoleonic war memorial cross, and it briefly gained wider notice as a 2012 Tour of Austria mountain stage.

compactRecord.rs: On B20 Traisental-Straße in Lilienfeld, 70 km SW of Vienna. Direct rail from St. Pölten (20 min). Abbey church open daily; cloister guided tours on request.
compactRecord.td: The largest Cistercian monastery complex in Austria, founded 1202 by Duke Leopold VI. Its Romanesque-Gothic church contains the oldest surviving cloister in the German-speaking world and a treasury of rare medieval illuminated manuscripts.
